correctness.rationale: The four hub-status predicates are exhaustively proved; a contractible subcomplex and an edge-cone intersect in the join of a two-point complex with a simplex skeleton. Homotopy pushout gives a double suspension, the simplex chain complex yields binomial sphere count, and natural Mayer–Vietoris and join Künneth give the integral exterior-power module including hub swap. The extracted exact program independently checked 54 cases and 892 full-group character instances. No finite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: Double stars are the full natural family of diameter-three trees with two branching centres. Their exact all-threshold sphere multiplicity is unexpectedly independent of leaf distribution, while a full integral graph-automorphism module (including the hub-exchange sign) distinguishes symmetry information not implied by ordinary homology ranks or vertex-decomposability. It is a complete motivated two-parameter homotopy classification, not an arbitrary finite case.
